result:
If I could change just one thing in the world, I would want everyone to carry a little more empathy in their hearts—the kind that lets us pause, truly listen, and try to understand the experiences and feelings of others, even when we disagree.

I imagine it as an invisible thread connecting us all, softening misunderstandings, inspiring kindness, and reminding us that we’re navigating this world together. It wouldn’t solve every problem overnight, but I believe it could gently reshape how we communicate, care for one another, and build communities.

What about you—if you could change one thing, what would it be? 😊
